name: Treatment Ledger
description: A concealed register from the House of Mercy. Read it to uncover the experiments and gain 10 Insight.
lore: Fever remedies fill the public register. Between its covers lies a second list: patient numbers, rising doses of crimson extract, discharge dates crossed out. Beside one number: 'Pulse absent. Movement resumed. Continue observation.' Later entries mention an emblem removed from the ward; after that, the handwriting grows hurried. A crest in the margin looks familiar to Rictor.
